url.title: Webhook URL
url.description: The absolute https URL to send to (e.g. your Make.com / Zapier / n8n catch hook).

payload.title: JSON Payload
payload.description: The JSON body to send. Use templates like {{ customer.name }} to inject call data. Ignored for GET/DELETE.

headers.title: Custom Headers
headers.description: Optional extra HTTP headers as key/value pairs.

hmacSecret.title: HMAC Secret
hmacSecret.description: Optional. If set, the raw body is signed with HMAC-SHA256 and the hex digest is sent in the signature header.

hmacHeader.title: HMAC Signature Header
hmacHeader.description: Header name for the HMAC signature.
